description: "What's your plan to pay for all this 'affordable' stuff? You offer no solutions, just your issues."It's a common question so let me lay out how we can approach this strategically and as a new representative. I want to focus on things that can actually pass, without asking Montanans for more out of their pockets. I oppose a flat income tax rate and I oppose a sales tax, because both would hit working families here the hardest. If affordability really is the priority, voters deserve to know which
